key_concepts: The 5Rs of waste management include reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, and repair
Reuse means using an item again or for another purpose
Recycle means making something into a new product
Old clothes and towels can be reused as cleaning rags
Empty plastic bottles can be recycled into new objects like toys
Recycling saves energy and conserves natural resources
Recycling helps protect the environment and reduce pollution
Reusing and recycling paper saves trees and reduces greenhouse gas emissions
Recycling reduces the need for raw materials and helps preserve rainforests
Recycling and reusing can save money and even earn extra income
Some materials like tissue and vegetable peelings cannot be recycled or reused
